import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_90/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_90/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_90/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_90/training_3.csv"
]

# Read all source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Extract only the 'occluded' column from each dataframe
occluded_dfs = [df[['occluded']] for df in dfs]

# Concatenate (union) all occluded columns vertically
union_df = pd.concat(occluded_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['occluded'] with integer type
# Ensure the 'occluded' column is integer type
union_df['occluded'] = union_df['occluded'].astype(int)

# Write the final target dataframe to the specified path without the index
union_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
